query: NVIDIA data center segment revenue for the last four reported quarters

output.content:
NVIDIA’s Data Center revenue for the last four reported quarters was: 

| Fiscal quarter | Quarter ended | Data Center revenue |
|---|---:|---:|
| Q2 FY2027 | July 26, 2026 | **$89.0 billion** |
| Q1 FY2027 | April 26, 2026 | **$75.2 billion** |
| Q4 FY2026 | January 25, 2026 | **$62.3 billion** |
| Q3 FY2026 | October 26, 2025 | **$51.2 billion** | 

Q2 FY2027 Data Center revenue was $89.0 billion, 18% higher sequentially and 117% above the prior-year quarter. [[1]] 
Q1 FY2027 Data Center revenue was $75.2 billion, up 21% sequentially and 92% year over year. [[2]] 
Q4 FY2026 Data Center revenue was $62.3 billion, up 22% from Q3 and 75% year over year. [[3]] 
Q3 FY2026 Data Center revenue was $51.2 billion, up 25% sequentially and 66% year over year. [[4]]
